haikus.haiku:
Coffee swirl, ice sweet
Creamy dream on winter spoon
Taste of sunrise warm
Happy #NationalCoffeeIceCreamDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Clock tick, task waits soft
Sunrise paints bright paper plans
Action blooms like spring
Happy #FightProcrastinationDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Silken threads entwine
Dancing shadows on her wall
Joyful heart beats strong
#HappyBirthdayJaneAddams from @ClamBakeSanta
